
The issue is that the `labels` from the dataset using `label_mode='categorical'` will be one-hot encoded vectors, not integer indices. So `labels[i]` is an array, not a single integer that can be used to index into `class_names`.

To fix this, we need to convert the one-hot encoded labels back to class indices. We can use `tf.argmax()` to get the index of the highest value (which corresponds to the class).

The fix should be:
```python
for images, labels in train_ds.take(1):
  for i in range(6):
    ax = plt.subplot(3, 3, i + 1)
    plt.imshow(images[i].numpy().astype("uint8"))
    plt.title(class_names[np.argmax(labels[i])])
    plt.axis("off")
```

This uses `np.argmax()` to find the index of the maximum value in the one-hot encoded label vector.
